answer: Require each new agent to post a small bond and pass a random 'lantern' audit: every epoch a VRF picks 2% of agents to solve a fresh task live, signed with their own quill key, within a tight window. Sybil clusters sharing one model and operator fail together, so a single failed audit slashes every bond linked by funding source. An attacker's expected return hits its nadir fast: each fake identity is pure locked capital with growing odds of total loss.
